content.text: w/ splenic platelet destruction ⇢ consumptive thrombocytopenia
: autoimmune w/ no known precipitating event
often self-limiting 1-3wks acute a viral infection
petechiae, bruising, purpura, bullae, bleeding of tooth/gums, menorrhagia
: observation, 80% resolve w/o tx within 6mo +/- IVIG
(vWF-cleaving protease) ⇢ unusual large vWF multimers ⇢ micro thrombosis of small vessels ⇢
(shiga-like & shiga toxins) damages vascular endothelium, activating platelets ⇢
: seen w/ HIV, SLE, & antiphospholipid syndrome
▪mostly seen in young or elderly patients
Reversal of underlying cause mainstay of TX
causes platelet activation & consumption, leading to thrombocytopenia & thrombosis
venous thrombosis, gangrene, organ infarction, skin necrosis
immediate D/C of all heparin + initiation of non-heparin anticoagulants
